item.title: Vegan food hall Plant City's Providence location to close Feb. 8
item.description: Plant City's Providence location is set to close this Sunday after six years in business. The vegan food hall announced its closure on Jan. 26, citing a reduction in customers over the past two years. Plant City's other locations in Barrington and Warwick will remain open.Plant City Providence is the world's first fully vegan food hall and marketplace. item.title: More than a moisturizer: Shea butter can remove toxic chemicals from water, Brown researchers find
item.description: Surfactants derived from shea butter, an ingredient found in many skin care products, may remediate contaminated water. item.title: Editorial: Brown's workforce development grants are an opportunity to invest in the future of R.I. education

item.title: How new legislation is helping R.I. fight off invasive green crabs
item.description: Green crabs have resided in New England waters for hundreds of years, but a new law - effective at the beginning of this year - is aiming to reduce the presence of the invasive species.The law authorizes the Rhode Island Department of Environmental Management to offer $10 commercial licenses to harvest green crabs.
